design.decision: Bid nil more often and protect it in play, covering the nil bidder's dangerous cards.
design.opponent: Revealed at scoring on a made nil; opponents should focus on breaking nils.
design.rationale: The +mult rung of Nil at common; it pays on the result rather than the bid (seed-nil-bid-mult) and multiplies the nil score itself.
design.draftText: +20 contract multiplier if your team makes a nil

history.note: draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-nilmade-mult); credited to both sources.
